The Company Imerys is the world’s leading supplier of mineral-based specialty solutions for the industry with €3.4 billion in revenue and 12,300 employees in 40 countries in 2025. The Group offers high value-added and functional solutions to a wide range of industries and fast-growing markets such as solutions for the energy transition and sustainable construction, as well as natural solutions for consumer goods. Imerys draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge, and expertise in material science to deliver solutions which contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance. As part of its commitment to responsible development, Imerys promotes environmentally friendly products and processes in addition to supporting its customers in their decarbonization efforts. Imerys is listed on Euronext Paris (France) with the ticker symbol NK.PA. The Position Events & Communication Specialist (Fixed-Term - Maternity Leave Replacement) Job Summary Recognized internationally as a market leader in graphite and carbon solutions, Imerys Graphite & Carbon serves a variety of growing industrial sectors including electric vehicles, polymers, engineering materials and refractories. Research and innovation are the drivers of all our solutions, developed at our own laboratories and produced in our own factories equipped using the most advanced technologies. Part of the Imerys Group, the world leader in mineral-based specialties for industry , Imerys Graphite & Carbon is headquartered in Switzerland with commercial offices and production sites around the globe. Role To join our Communication team in Bironico (Switzerland), we are looking for a highly organized and proactive professional for a temporary role covering a maternity leave: Events & Communication Specialist (Fixed-Term - Maternity Leave Replacement) This temporary position is to cover a maternity leave. In this dynamic position, you lead the planning and execution of trade shows and branding initiatives, ensuring consistent brand positioning, engaging experiences, and impactful brand visibility across all touchpoints. You will work closely with the Communication Manager to ensure consistent brand messaging and impactful engagement across all touchpoints. Main Responsibilities Manage end-to-end planning, coordination, and execution of trade shows and employer branding activities. Oversee logistics, budgeting, and vendor management to ensure high-quality, on-brand delivery. Collaborate with Business Development & Marketing, as well as R&D to design event promotional materials (booth visuals, banners, brochures, and social media content). Evaluate event outcomes, collect feedback, and analyze ROI and lead generation in collaboration with Business Development & Marketing and Sales. Support the development of internal communication campaigns, including content creation for intranet, newsletters, and internal events. Contribute to communication initiatives on sustainability, safety, and innovation. Profile Required Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, or related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in end-to-end event management. Excellent written and spoken English and Italian (C1 level or equivalent). Knowledge of German and/or French is considered an asset. Experience with marketing automation tools or CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Mailchimp, Brevo). Project management: demonstrates strong organizational, prioritization, and multitasking capabilities. Proactive and accountable: you take initiative, anticipate needs, and deliver with ownership. Creative and curious: enjoys finding new ways to engage audiences and bring ideas to life. Collaborative and team-oriented: you work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners, fostering team spirit and a commitment to continuous improvement. Structured and solution-oriented: manages multiple deadlines while maintaining focus on quality and results We offer an attractive and dynamic working atmosphere in a truly multicultural and multinational environment with competitive compensation and benefits packages. We apply the collective employment agreement (CEA) for Switzerland’s mechanical and electrical engineering industries, which guarantees the employees of the signatory companies fair and up-to-date working conditions. In addition, Imerys Graphite & Carbon is very committed to protecting the health of its employees, offering a series of advantages aimed at improving safety and a healthy work-life balance. The company is dedicated to the continuous improvement of its activities to reduce its environmental impact. Company Description Would you like to work in a technological company dedicated to the development of medical solutions? Inpeco is the world leader in the automation of clinical laboratories , where we create innovative robotic solutions to manage biological samples. Our systems reduce the possibility of human error, limit the risks of contamination and guarantee complete traceability of the sample. Our solutions support over 2.700 clinical laboratories worldwide . The Inpeco Group has its headquarters in Novazzano (Switzerland) , a production plant in Val della Torre (Torino) , a site dedicated to Innovative Projects in Pula (Sardinia) , a small site in Verona and five reference locations for the foreign market in Belgium, United States, Germany, France and Spain. What are you waiting for? Come join the Inpeco team and innovate with us! Position As a Design Quality Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, safety, and regulatory compliance of Inpeco's medical device products throughout their entire lifecycle. As part of the Quality team, you will lead Design Quality activities, providing strategic direction and technical guidance to ensure that product development processes meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business objectives. Collaborating closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, and other cross-functional stakeholders, you will oversee Design Quality activities for both hardware and software development, ensuring the effective implementation of Design Controls, risk management, verification and validation, and design transfer processes. You will also lead and develop the Design Quality Engineering team, fostering a strong quality culture, promoting continuous improvement, and ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the product development lifecycle. Main Responsibilities Lead and oversee global Design Quality activities throughout the entire product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, international standards, and internal Quality Management System procedures. Drive the implementation and maintenance of Design Controls, ensuring effective management of design inputs, outputs, design reviews, verification, validation, design transfer, and design changes. Act as the Design Quality subject matter expert for hardware and software development, providing technical guidance and supporting the review and approval of design documentation, technical specifications, procedures, test protocols, and reports. Ensure Design Quality oversight of software development activities, including compliance with IEC 62304, software risk management, cybersecurity and AI-related regulatory requirements, and software verification and validation. Oversee product risk management activities throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with ISO 14971, appropriate risk identification and evaluation, implementation of risk control measures, and maintenance of risk management documentation. Ensure alignment between design activities, risk management, verification and validation results, and post-market data to support ongoing product safety and effectiveness. Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Suppliers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure that quality and regulatory requirements are effectively integrated into product development and lifecycle management. Lead, manage, and develop the Design Quality Engineering team, providing technical guidance, coaching, mentoring, and performance management while fostering accountability and a strong quality mindset. Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring the effective management and resolution of Design Quality-related findings. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance Design Quality processes, strengthen regulatory compliance, and support global business objectives. Requirements Skills and Experience Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. At least 7 years of experience in Quality Engineering within the medical device industry, including at least 4 years of specific experience in Design Quality. At least 1 year of experience in people management, with demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical teams. Strong knowledge of applicable medical device regulations and international standards, including ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820, and EU MDR 2017/745 or EU IVDR 2017/746. Proven experience in Design Controls and medical device design and development processes, including design reviews, verification, validation, and design transfer. Solid understanding of hardware and software development processes within the medical device industry. Experience in product risk management throughout the product lifecycle, including risk analysis, risk evaluation, risk control, and risk management documentation. Knowledge of applicable software development standards, particularly IEC 62304, as well as cybersecurity and emerging AI-related regulatory requirements. Experience supporting internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and risk-based approach to decision-making. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, drive initiatives, and deliver results within established timelines. Proactive, flexible, and adaptable, with the ability to operate effectively in an international and rapidly evolving environment. Fluent in English; Italian is a plus. Nice to Have Previous experience in a global medical device organization and in managing international or cross-functional teams. Experience with both hardware and software medical device development, particularly within complex or integrated systems. Knowledge of cybersecurity requirements and emerging regulatory frameworks for AI-enabled medical devices. Experience with post-market surveillance, complaint handling, and the integration of post-market data into product risk management and design activities. Experience with process improvement methodologies and Quality Management System optimization. Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools. Ability to promote and communicate quality objectives effectively, influence stakeholders, challenge existing practices, and drive continuous improvement. Other information What we offer Dynamic work environment where you can make a difference and grow your career International work location in our headquarter in Switzerland (Novazzano) Flexible working hours Working time account: possibility to accrue additional hours of free time in addition to holidays Additional contribution to the pension fund Professional and non-professional accident insurance Company restaurant Incentives for mobility by public transport Agreements for bank account, credit card and personal purchases Opportunity of professional and salary growth through various initiatives: Annual performance appraisal in order to evaluate the achievement of individual objectives Internal job posting to apply for career opportunities in Inpeco, even between different locations Annual salary review linked to performance and professional development Continuous training on the job, through meetings or conferences, seminars and events.
